0.0: Oh, no! Have you really lost the Ludibrium Medal? That's a valuable and rare item... You can't enter the Origin of Clocktower without it. What should we do now? Do you really want to give it another shot?

yes.0: Alright. I may not be blessed with many abilities, so you may need to talk to #bFlo#k, who's in Path of Time.

no.0: You don't want to take another crack on the challenge. It's not easy defeating Papulatus.

1.0: I also heard from Mr. Bouffon about the medal. I'll give you the one that I'm wearing right now, then.

yes.0: How do I have this Ludibrium medal? there's a way...there's a way... kind of like magic.

npc.0: #bFlo#k is at the entrance towards #bWarped Path of Time #k

QuestInfo.name: The Lost Medal
QuestInfo.0: If I lost the Ludibrium Medal, then I better go see Mr. Bouffon.
QuestInfo.1: I told #rMr. Bouffon#k that I lost the Ludibrium Medal. He told me he was going to give me another chance and that I should go see #rFlo#k immediately.
QuestInfo.2: I was able to regain the lost Ludibrium Medal from Flo. I should seriously take care of Papulatus this time.
